race.comment: TEARS ARE FLOWING (1) is the horse to beat after a second at this track over 1000m, where she was bumped at the start, settled further back than ideal and still beat all bar one. She had won here the start prior as odds-on favourite, owns a win around 1300m and gets to this third-up from an easier assignment. On top. LADY FIREBALL (4) is the danger with winning form on the board after a Mdn success at this track, and her one win from two starts at the distance puts her right in this. WARREGO (3) brings consistent BM58 form, including a closing fifth and a sound fourth, with weight relief helping his claims. Include. MY LUNA (8) is harder to sell as a win play with 13 starts without a victory, but her third to LADY FIREBALL came after racing wide and makes her a minor hope if she holds that form. STYLISH PRINCE (2) closed off nicely when beaten 1.75 lengths last time here. Can contest for a place.
